sourceRefs.locator: Letter 127.12–14: news from Rome, the attack on Marcella, Principia and refuge at the basilica of Paul; letter addressed to Principia after the event

summary.de: Römische Christin, über deren Erfahrung bei der Plünderung Hieronymus im Rückblick an ihre Gefährtin Principia schrieb.
summary.en: Roman Christian whose experience of the sack Jerome recounted afterwards in a letter to her companion Principia.
